note: Historical local desk items, newest first. See local/NEWS_ARCHIVE.md.

items.label: SR-17 SB · I-280
items.text: Traffic hazard on SB SR-17 at I-280 (under), San Jose (~1:56 PM PT; CHP 1549 / CAD 260910GG1549). IN HOV LN. Units assigned/enroute ~1:59 PM PT. Affects 17/280 junction near Campbell.

items.label: SR-17 NB · SR-9
items.text: Traffic break on NB SR-17 at the SR-9 E offramp, San Jose / Los Gatos (~1:52 PM PT; CHP 1542 / CAD 260910GG1542). Caltrans-requested break for trash pickup; CT 1023 NB 17 JSO Lark St in CD; hold break until finished. Affects NB 17 into Campbell / over the hill.

items.label: SR-17 NB · Hamilton Ave
items.text: Traffic break on NB SR-17 at the Hamilton Ave offramp, San Jose / Campbell (~12:09 PM PT; CHP 1304 / CAD 260910GG1304). Still active on GGCC board ~12:49 PM PT. Detail narrative empty on CAD select. Prior same-location break CHP 1190 / 260910GG1190 (~11:29) is off board — different id; this is a follow-on / new break at same spot. Affects Union Ave / Hamilton / 17.

items.label: SR-17 NB · Hamilton Ave
items.text: Traffic break requested to start on NB SR-17 at Camden to pick up misc debris on tight RHS; debris scattered between Hamilton and Stevenson (NB 17 JSO Hamilton), San Jose / Campbell corridor (~11:29 AM PT; CHP 1190 / CAD 260910GG1190). Units assigned + enroute ~11:34 AM PT. Affects Campbell / Union Ave via 17–Hamilton–Camden.

items.label: I-280 NB · Wolfe
items.text: No-injury traffic collision on NB I-280 at the Wolfe Rd offramp, San Jose / Cupertino edge (~9:54 AM PT; CHP 0934 / CAD 260910GG0934). CHP mobile detail log empty at check. May slow NB 280 near Wolfe — not Union Ave / 17 / 85 Campbell core.

items.label: SR-85 NB · Blossom Hill
items.text: NB SR-85 JSO Blossom Hill hit-and-run no injuries (CHP 0308 / FSP GGFSP0011; CHP closed ~7:19 AM PT).

items.label: SR-17 SB · Camden
items.text: Report of fire on SB SR-17 just north of the Camden Ave offramp (San Jose/Campbell), ~7:02 AM PT (CHP 0357 / CAD 260910GG0357). Unknown what’s burning; RHS; smells and sees smoke ~7:05; unit assigned/enroute ~7:06. Possible commute delays near Camden.

items.label: SR-17 NB · SR-9
items.text: Traffic hazard on NB SR-17 just south of SR-9 (Los Gatos / Campbell corridor), ~7:27 PM PT (CHP 2435). Unit assigned/enroute/at scene ~7:27. Detail log empty at check. Affects 17 travel from Campbell south.

items.label: US-101 NB → I-280
items.text: Unknown-injury collision that became a vehicle fire on the NB US-101 to NB I-280 connector, San Jose (~7:20–7:24 PM PT; CHP 2423 / related 2434). Gray Mazda 6 vs wall blocking the connector ramp; vehicle fully engulfed by ~7:23–7:29; fire notified. Affects 280 access.

items.label: SR-85 SB · Bascom Ave
items.text: Hit and run, no injuries on SB SR-85 at the Bascom Ave on-ramp (~6:54–7:00 PM PT; CHP 2364 / FSP 0179). White Ram van vs white Dodge Dakota; vehicles driveable; CHP requested for 1110 on a company vehicle; unit assigned ~7:00 PM. Relevant to Campbell / Union Ave via 85.

items.label: SR-85 SB · Saratoga Ave
items.text: Unknown-injury collision on SB SR-85 at the Saratoga Ave offramp (San Jose / Campbell edge), ~6:21–6:25 PM PT (CHP 260909GG2262; companion FSP 260909GGFSP0167, Sb 85 JNO Saratoga ~6:25). Detail log empty on CHP mobile. Affects Campbell-area 85 / Saratoga access near Union Ave.

items.label: I-880 SB · US-101
items.text: Collision on SB I-880 just north of the US-101 connector, San Jose (~5:19–5:21 PM PT; CHP 2079 / FSP 0152). Evolved to a no-injury multi-vehicle on the RHS / gore point; unit at scene ~5:43 PM. May slow Campbell↔north SJ via 880/101; Union Ave local fine.

items.label: I-280 / SR-17 · Moorpark
items.text: Report of fire at the I-280 N / SR-17 S connector / Moorpark Ave area, San Jose (~5:17 PM PT; CHP #2070). Near Winchester / Santana Row / Campbell approaches; may snarl the 280↔17 interchange. Detail narrative empty on CHP mobile at check.

items.label: I-280 NB · Meridian Ave
items.text: No-injury collision on NB I-280 just north of the Meridian Ave N on-ramp, San Jose (~4:29–4:33 PM PT; CHP #1925). Three vehicles (gray Nissan Versa, silver Toyota Prius, gray Kia) on RHS; no tow requested; unit assigned/enroute 4:33 PM. Active on GGCC ~4:35 PM. May affect evening NB 280; not on Campbell surface streets.

items.label: SR-17 NB · Hamilton Ave
items.text: Traffic hazard on NB SR-17 at the Hamilton Ave offramp, Campbell / San Jose (~3:19 PM PT; CHP #1715). Still active on GGCC ~3:52 PM. Detail narrative unavailable from CHP mobile. Affects Union Ave / Hamilton / 17.

items.label: SR-85 NB · Saratoga Ave
items.text: Traffic hazard on NB SR-85 just south of the Saratoga Ave offramp (San Jose / Campbell), ~1:48 PM PT (CHP #1448). Tarp blocking lane 1; no responsible vehicle seen; unit assigned ~2:25 PM; still active ~2:25 PM. Relevant to Campbell / Union Ave approaches on NB 85.

items.label: SR-85 NB · Evelyn Ave
items.text: Collision with ambulance en route on NB SR-85 just south of the Evelyn Ave offramp, Mountain View (~1:29–1:33 PM PT; CHP 1398 / FSP 0088). White unknown sedan vs RHS wall; blocking lanes 2–3. Still active ~1:38 PM. Affects NB 85 north of Campbell (Mountain View), not Union Ave local.

items.label: I-280 NB · Race St
items.text: Multi-vehicle collision on NB I-280 at the Race St offramp, San Jose (~1:23–1:25 PM PT; CHP 1381 / FSP 0086). Injury status unknown; 3 vehicles (silver Kia, black Mazda, gray Honda); unit blocking Race St offramp; tow for silver Kia; FSP ETA ~15 min around 1:35 PM. Still active ~1:38 PM. Affects 280 near downtown SJ / Race exit.

items.label: SR-87 SB · W Capitol Expwy
items.text: Report of fire on SB SR-87 just north of the W Capitol Expwy offramp (SB 87 JNO CAPX), San Jose, ~1:04–1:05 PM PT (CHP #1328). Black smoke on RHS; transferred to fire; unit assigned/enroute 1:11 PM; still active ~1:14 PM. About 5 miles east of Campbell / Union Ave; may slow SB 87 / Capitol approaches.

items.label: I-880 NB · Bascom Ave
items.text: Traffic hazard on NB I-880 just north of the Bascom Ave on-ramp (NB 880 JNO BASCOM), San Jose, ~12:39–12:41 PM PT. Metal frame in lane 1 and ladder in lane 4; no associated vehicles (CHP #1271). Unit assigned/enroute 12:41 PM; still active ~12:58 PM. Matters for Bascom / east-of-Campbell 880 access from Union Ave.

items.label: I-280 SB → NB SR-85
items.text: Traffic hazard on the SB I-280 transition to NB SR-85 (San Jose / Cupertino connector), ~12:07–12:08 PM PT. Black bag in lane 2 (CHP #1210). Unit assigned/enroute 12:16 PM; still active ~12:25 PM. May delay 280→85. Union Ave / Campbell via SR-17 unaffected.

items.label: Moorpark Ave · San Jose
items.text: Collision with ambulance en route at 2400 Moorpark Ave, San Jose (~12:04 PM PT; CHP 260909GG1189). Near I-280 / Winchester, a couple miles north of Campbell / Union Ave.

items.label: SR-85 SB · Blossom Hill Rd
items.text: Traffic hazard on southbound SR-85 at the Blossom Hill Rd offramp (San Jose), ~11:16–11:19 AM PT. CHP and San Jose FSP listed. Can slow SB 85 through South San Jose toward Campbell.

items.label: Almaden Expwy → NB 85
items.text: Collision on the Almaden Expressway on-ramp transition to northbound 85 in San Jose. Injury status unknown; units assigned. Closer to the Campbell / South San Jose side of 85.

items.label: I-880 NB · US-101 / First St
items.text: Prius vs motorcycle on northbound I-880 just south of US-101 / First St in San Jose. Both on the right-hand shoulder; motorcycle tow still being arranged around 9:15 AM.

items.label: SR-85 SB · Fremont Ave
items.text: Multi-vehicle collision on southbound SR-85 at the Fremont Ave offramp (Mountain View / Los Altos). Briefly blocked all lanes; ambulance, Mountain View Fire, and a tow for a Honda HRV. Still on CHP CAD around the 9:15 AM check. Matters for southbound 85 toward Campbell.
